ten_minute_conversion: Select exact KST minute multiples of ten; never round, interpolate or carry target labels.
spatial_protocol: For each reserved validation group, exclude every station in that group from model fit, preprocessing, internal threshold choice and dynamic reference inputs. Use first-winter external observations only for development; never use next-winter external observations as model inputs or training labels.
validation_gate: Before obtaining next-winter labels, save selected model(s), thresholds, input source hashes, nine-station predictions and their hashes. Evaluate the reserved winter once; do not tune afterward. Other development-only comparisons are not final evaluation.
final_comparison: Compare the original-input baseline and a development-selected augmented candidate on the same valid station/time pairs. Report TP, FP, FN, AP, station daily macro, fixed actual-ice-day F1, false-alarm days, full versus partial coverage and road-temperature MAE/RMSE/BIAS. Primary improvement requires both FP and FN reductions; neither a changed denominator nor threshold movement alone proves improvement.
limitations: Public static metadata does not establish historical sensor availability or spatial independence.
The nine stations lie along the three routes and are not all inside Jeonbuk.
Spatial groups were chosen using metadata only, before new winter observations were opened.
Historical coordinates, valid SFS, sensor installation and gaps must be audited.
Official protected stations 12410, 33411 and 23402 remain excluded permanently.
